content:
Meta has launched a brand new iPhone app, officially named Seller, a Facebook app. This new Meta app is designed for Facebook users managing item listings on Marketplace, the social network's virtual store for physical goods.

This new Seller app is designed exclusively for iPhone, but it also runs on iPad and Mac.

Here is the official description of this new app:

Seller is a selling app built for Facebook Marketplace. Centralise your listings, communicate with buyers, and track how your sales are performing — all in one place. Stay on top of what needs your attention. Your seller home dashboard surfaces what matters most — items to ship, buyers waiting for a reply, listings to reprice — alongside a snapshot of how your sales are performing. Create listings fast. Upload a photo and Meta AI fills in the details — title, description, price, category — so you can publish quickly. Manage your inventory at scale. Reprice, relist or remove items in bulk. Create multiple listings at once. All your buyer messages, together in one place. Buyer conversations live here, separate from your personal chats. Spot the buyers who mean business, reply faster and never miss a message. See what's working. Find out which listings are getting the most views, saves and enquiries. Get pricing suggestions and relist recommendations based on real sales data.

Seller is the second brand new iPhone app Meta has launched this week. The company also released an AI-powered children's storytelling app called StoryKit, though it is currently only in limited testing in select markets.

This brand new Facebook Marketplace Seller app is now fully available for free on the App Store. Meta also shared an announcement post about this new app today.
